experiment_baseline_commit_rule: The experiment baseline is the freeze commit containing this protocol; record its SHA in each run record after the freeze, without rewriting this manifest.

controlled_environment.confirm_mode: advisor consent followed by /eio handoff confirm and immediate resume confirmation

workload.title: Read-only Handoff Incident Inspector
workload.purpose: Add an offline, deterministic and privacy-safe inspector for handoff incidents without performing recovery or changing threshold logic.
deliverables: package.json inspect script and src/index.mjs export
requirements: Open the existing Guardian SQLite database read-only and never migrate or mutate it; inspection must also leave artifact bytes unchanged.

Inspect one handoff by ID across handoff projection, latch, append-only journal ordering, runner binding, artifact index, sealed checkpoint and manifest, and only Pi session header/lineage metadata when available; never emit conversation content.
Return a versioned allowlisted report with deterministic ordering and no capture timestamp. Repeating against identical bytes must produce byte-identical JSON.
Classify the outcome as CONSISTENT_TERMINAL, PAUSED_RECOVERABLE, FAIL_CLOSED, or AMBIGUOUS and emit only predeclared action codes. Unknown schema/state is fail-closed.

RESUME_DISPATCH_UNKNOWN, digest mismatch, missing required authority, journal order violation, binding mismatch, duplicate/unknown target, or unreadable evidence must never recommend retry or automatic resume.

The CLI accepts --db, --guardian-root, --handoff and --format json; stdout is report-only, diagnostics go to stderr; exit 0 means consistent, 2 means a safety finding, and 64 means invalid invocation.
Use GuardianError/invariant conventions, export the public inspector API from src/index.mjs, add npm run inspect, and add no runtime dependency.

Tests use temporary local fixtures, block fetch, cover a healthy resumed handoff, paused recoverable handoff, ambiguous replacement creation, dispatch unknown, missing/tampered artifact, journal-order and binding mismatch, unknown state/schema, read-only byte preservation, recursive privacy allowlist, deterministic output, and CLI exit codes.
Document authority boundaries, decision table, CLI examples, privacy, exit codes, and the explicit limit that this tool diagnoses but does not repair or recover.
Do not implement Cost Guard, supervised-auto, crash recovery, provider integration, adaptive advice, or any change to context threshold behavior/default.

phases.name: contract-and-core
phases.acceptance: Inspector contract, read-only authority adapters, validations, classification, and stable report are implemented.

phases.name: cli-and-integration
phases.acceptance: CLI, exports and package integration satisfy the fixed arguments, output and exit-code contract.

phases.name: tests-and-documentation
phases.acceptance: Required offline fixture matrix and user/authority documentation are present; implementation session stops at READY_FOR_COLD_REVIEW.

phases.name: cold-review-and-fix
phases.acceptance: A fresh no-history session records requirement-by-requirement findings, fixes all blocking findings, and stops at READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE.

workload_prompt: Execute protocol H2-02A-PILOT-1 workload WL-HANDOFF-INCIDENT-INSPECTOR-1 from the local byte-identical file .guardian/calibration/pilot-protocol.json. Read that file, TASK_PLAN.md, and only relevant repository sources. Do not change the protocol file, the handoff threshold implementation/default, model/reasoning, or scope. If TASK_PLAN.md is still the H2 calibration ledger, first convert it into a valid workload ledger with WCP-1 current, WCP-2..WCP-4 planned, this protocol file in minimal_reads, and the exact requirements and completion marker preserved; keep it current after each phase so an Eiopago handoff can resume without conversation history. Implement WCP-1 through WCP-3, using no external service and never inventing test results. Then stop with exactly READY_FOR_COLD_REVIEW. In the mandatory fresh no-history session, the same prompt applies: when TASK_PLAN.md shows WCP-4 current, independently review the diff requirement by requirement, write docs/reviews/handoff-incident-inspector-review.md with finding severity/status, fix every blocking finding, update the ledger, and stop with exactly READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE. Do not run or simulate RUN-40/RUN-50/RUN-60 setup, do not copy conversation history, and do not claim acceptance commands passed unless their actual outputs are supplied by the operator.
